journey.name: Paste Video Link and Quality Picker
journey.description: Tests entering or pasting a supported video link (YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok) and verifies that the quality picker dialog opens with resolutions (1080p, 720p, etc.) and MP3 audio options.

actions.action: Ensure the app is on the Home screen
Tap the URL input field to focus it
Enter a video link into the input field
Verify that the analysis loading indicator appears
Verify that the Quality Picker dialog opens
Verify that video formats with clean labels (e.g. 1080p HD, 720p HD, 480p, 360p) and MP3 audio options are listed
Verify that each format item shows resolution and format badges
